chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Nasr, from Abu Al-Hasan Al-Rida (peace be upon him), who said:
He said regarding the divorced woman: When the proof is established that he has divorced her since such and such (a day), and her waiting period has passed, then she is irrevocably divorced.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on a divorced woman when her husband is absent and the waiting period has passed?
ai.summary: Imam al-Rida (AS) establishes that in cases of absence, the finality of divorce (ba'in) is contingent upon the verification of the specific divorce date through valid testimony, after which the waiting period (iddah) is calculated from that proven date. This ruling underscores the Shia jurisprudential emphasis on evidentiary proof in resolving uncertainties regarding marital status when the husband is not present to confirm the event personally.
